content: We have mass spectrum data. Need to identify elements definitively based on isotope distribution patterns visible. Look at peaks: m/z values around 232-240. Likely a molecular ion with isotopic pattern. Need to see isotopic spacing: differences ~1.00335 (mass difference between isotopes). Let's compute differences: 231.96544 to 232.96883 diff ~1.00339. Next 233.96320 diff ~0.99437? Actually 232.96883 to 233.96320 diff ~0.99437 (close to 1). Then 233.96320 to 234.966566 diff ~1.00337. Then 235.96061 diff ~0.994? etc. This pattern suggests presence of chlorine (Cl-35 and Cl-37) gives ~2 Da spacing with characteristic 3:1 ratio. Bromine gives ~2 Da with 1:1 ratio. Here we see many peaks spaced ~1 Da, not 2. Could be presence of sulfur (32,33,34,36) with spacing 1 Da and relative intensities. Carbon isotopic pattern (13C) gives small M+1 peaks but not many. The pattern shows many peaks with decreasing intensities, maybe due to multiple isotopes of elements like Cl, Br, S, etc. Let's retrieve isotopic distribution to compare.
